# anr-install

Installs ANR FG (Apex Neural Rendering frame generation, github.com/apex-compute/ANR) into a PC game with OptiScaler, and spoofs the GPU so the game offers DLSS frame generation for ANR to replace. Keeps per-game spoof recipes and results. Use when the user asks to install, set up, update, spoof, troubleshoot or uninstall ANR FG in a game, or asks how to get DLSS frame gen on an RTX 20/30, GTX 16, AMD or Intel card for ANR.

Ships in the [`gaming`](../../README.md) plugin of [Uraxii/dotai](https://github.com/Uraxii/dotai). The agent reads [SKILL.md](SKILL.md); this file is for people.

## Install

Claude Code:

```
/plugin marketplace add Uraxii/dotai
/plugin install gaming@Uraxii
```

Codex CLI:

```
codex plugin marketplace add Uraxii/dotai --ref main
codex plugin add gaming@uraxii
```

Copilot CLI:

```
copilot plugin marketplace add Uraxii/dotai
copilot plugin install gaming@Uraxii
```

For other harnesses, see the [repository README](https://github.com/Uraxii/dotai#install).
